**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is (e.g., The AI agent gets confused when reading `graph.md`).

**Expected behavior**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

**Screenshots or Chat Logs**
If applicable, paste the AI chat logs or screenshots to help explain your problem.
